title: Website status input (v0.5, D36)
description: Input of the website status rules, used by the website-status vectors: what the gateway (or the MVP-20 central dashboard, merged over every gateway the website runs on) knows about one website over the last 5 minutes. The result is {status, reasons} (contract/websites.Status): status ok | attention ("bitte ansehen") | disrupted ("gestört") | unknown ("keine Messwerte"), reasons in a fixed order. Counts are exact counters of the monitoring rings (TrafficCounters); hints are HealthHints with their code and level.

tracked.description: The website has its own series (one of the first 32 websites); false: its traffic is only in _other.

monitoring.description: monitoring.enabled (on every gateway it runs on).

traffic.description: Counters of the website over the last 5 minutes (sum over its gateways). Absent: no numbers (monitoring off or untracked).

site_hints.description: Hints computed for this website from its own counters (codes upstream_errors, upstream_slow, fail_closed, traffic_spike).

servers.description: Every gateway the website runs on (one on the built-in dashboard).

state.description: ok; not_ready: the gate is not ready or baseline protection is off, so schild answers 503 (fail closed); unreachable: the central dashboard has no answer from this gateway (MVP-20 only).

hints.description: Server-wide hints of this gateway (host codes and schild internals).

serverHint.description: Server-wide hint codes: the host and schild's own shared resources. store_near_cap, store_cap_unreachable and storage_budget (schild's own event store) mark only the server and are no reason of a website (D36 open items, D38).
